reviewer: Codex source, specification and evidence review

formal_specification.domain: M in Q^(m x n), with m,n natural numbers represented by checked BasicMatrix dimensions. Q values have denominator > 0 and gcd(numerator,denominator)=1. No floating or fixed-width coefficient path is admitted.
formal_specification.candidate: U in Q^(m x r), V in Q^(r x n), L in Q^(r x m), R in Q^(n x r), with r <= min(m,n). All four stored candidate matrices independently pass canonical-Q admission.
formal_specification.acceptance: M = U*V AND L*U = I_r AND V*R = I_r. Equality includes matrix shape. The certificate stores r and a digest of the admitted mathematical value M at that time, not an alias to a mutable caller variable.
formal_specification.replay: verify_against(M2) returns Ok only after digest equality and re-admission of the same owned U,V,L,R against M2. Digest collision alone cannot bypass the matrix equalities.
formal_specification.production: certify_rank is a fallible candidate producer followed by the same independent checker. For a zero-area matrix it constructs the unique rank-zero shapes without iterating metadata-only rows/columns. Producer error is not a rank-zero result.
formal_specification.authority: AuthorityEffect None. These are finite exact linear-algebra claims, not a physical derivation, publication, cross-repository origin attestation or completed formal proof of Rust crash freedom.
formal_specification.checked_model: proofs/RankCertificate.lean: actual Q-matrix rank, successful admission, rejection of arbitrary explicit failures/failed predicates, exact first-error preservation and arithmetic/index bounds. Checked with Lean 4.33.1 and pinned Mathlib.

invariant_argument: Over Q, rank(UV) <= r, because U has r columns. From M=UV this gives rank(M) <= r.
Associativity gives LMR = L(UV)R = (LU)(VR) = I_r. Thus r = rank(I_r) = rank(LMR) <= rank(M). Combine both inequalities. For r=0 the same empty-matrix identities imply M=0.

try_admit checks canonical coefficients before scalar multiplication, then all shapes before identity construction, then each displayed identity. Its final struct construction is dominated by all checks. The input is borrowed immutably and witness matrices are owned.

certify_rank may propose arbitrary producer output, but neither producer branch constructs RankCertificate directly. A returned certificate therefore still requires all acceptance checks. Elimination correctness is not a soundness premise of the checker.

The checked Lean model and the source-level refinement audit jointly support finite certificate invariant preservation. The model is not presented as a machine-checked Rust/callee crash-freedom proof.

Storage audit: safe constructors and BasicMatrix serde preserve len=data_rows*data_cols with checked multiplication; index(row,col) checks row<rows and col<cols and checked offset arithmetic. Thus subsequent private data indexing has a mathematical bound. The sealed Q field instance excludes fixed-width and floating coefficient implementations.

Producer bounds audit: a found pivot has pivot_row<rows, so incrementing pivot_row cannot overflow; inversion checks doubled grid dimensions before allocation, and r<n,c<n imply n+c<2n for augmented-grid extraction. The checked bound lemmas and source-stage relation discharge these finite index obligations under the declared runtime contracts.

failure_paths.coefficient_domain: InvalidRational before try_admit arithmetic or producer elimination; tests inject zero/negative denominators and noncanonical fractions in every role.
failure_paths.dimensions: CertificateMismatch(rank dimension) before allocating I_r, or ShapeMismatch for any mismatched witness shape; safe storage constructors enforce data.len() == rows*cols.
failure_paths.identity_replay: MatrixError from multiplication or CertificateMismatch with M=UV / LU=I / VR=I; no partial certificate is returned.
failure_paths.producer: RankReductionFailed retains ExactLinearAlgebraError, RankInverseFailed retains ExactFieldError, and checked matrix errors propagate. Neither failure is converted to rank zero.
failure_paths.binding: CertificateMismatch(matrix binding) or a replay error; verify_against does not accept a digest in place of the algebraic equalities.

rust_model_refinement.assurance: Source-level refinement audit of the pinned Rust code to the checked model. This is not a mechanized compiler/MIR equivalence proof or a Rust crash-freedom certificate.
representation: BasicMatrix stores private rows/cols/data. Safe construction checks rows*cols with checked_mul and data length equality. Its serde implementation calls the same constructor; set/get do not change shape. Thus row/column indices refine Fin m and Fin n after checked bounds.

admit_coefficients rejects denominator <= 0 or gcd(numerator,denominator) != 1 for M,U,V,L,R. Canonical BigRational values have a unique Q interpretation, so derived exact matrix equality agrees with entrywise Q equality. Scalar operations are monomorphic BigRational, not arbitrary caller-supplied numeric implementations.

check_shapes refines all four witness shapes to the model Candidate m n r and bounds r by min(m,n). Shape/product failures return typed errors before construction; the model represents any such refusal as an unsuccessful extra check.
success_relation: try_admit has exactly one successful RankCertificate struct literal. It is dominated by coefficient admission, shape checks, identity allocation, M=UV, LU=I and VR=I. The Rust comparison UV==M is the symmetric form of the first model equality; the other two are identical. admit_success and admit_success_rank establish the invariant and rank conclusion.

certify_rank has two successful routes: the zero-area proposal and the elimination/Gram proposal. Both call try_admit. No row-reduction rank field or inverse result is itself trusted as a certificate. Producer errors propagate before admission, matching producer_failure.

verify_against first refuses a binding mismatch and then calls try_admit on the owned witness clone. Success therefore refines a fresh admission for the supplied matrix; the hash is not used as a substitute for the algebraic equations.
failure_relation: Each explicit Result error is propagated with ? or wrapped in a source-preserving HomologicalError variant. Failed equalities return CertificateMismatch. No error branch constructs a certificate or returns a default rank. explicit_failure and failed_predicate exclude every successful model result after a refused check.

Fallible operations may occur between equality checks; the model rejection property is independent of their placement, and first_error_preserved applies to the actual flattened sequence of Result guards. It preserves an arbitrary typed error payload, not merely an error tag. RankReductionFailed and RankInverseFailed retain the original producer error; singular and nonsquare source variants are exercised.

The borrowed matrix is never mutated. Producer reduction starts from a clone, and all scratch values/candidate matrices are owned Rust values. Error unwinding drops those values without exposing a partial certificate or mutating a previously admitted one. No unmanaged handle, async task, FFI export or mutable global is introduced by the subject.
logical_panic_obligations: Checked storage gives len=rows*cols. Every backend element access first checks row<rows and col<cols. row_major_index_lt proves row*cols+col<len; checked index arithmetic and valid allocated shape prevent wrapping or bounds panics.

The local inverse uses an augmented n by 2n grid only after checked dimension/cost arithmetic. augmented_column_lt proves n+col<2n for col<n. Its grid row operations iterate admitted row/column ranges; the same row-major bound justifies their internal indexing.

Row reduction increments pivot_row only after a nonzero pivot is found in pivot_row..rows. Hence pivot_row<rows, and pivot_increment_fits proves the increment stays within the represented rows bound. Both row-reduction implementations select a nonzero pivot before reciprocal/division; the sealed canonical Q instance excludes division by an admitted zero pivot.

identity_area_le proves r*r<=m*n from the admitted r<=m and r<=n bounds. Matrix constructors/reservations still propagate typed overflow/allocation refusals. Zero-area metadata bypasses row-reduction enumeration and is independently replayed by the checker.
construction_census: The only production struct-literal constructor is the successful end of try_admit. certify_rank delegates to it. Clone preserves the same immutable fields; Eq and Debug are observers. There is no Deserialize, Default or unchecked public constructor for RankCertificate.

rank, matrix_hash and candidate return a value or shared references. Candidate mutability belongs to untrusted RankCandidate values before admission; a shared borrow from a certificate cannot invoke BasicMatrix mutation. Ordinary safe-Rust ownership and the fixed scalar types prevent a caller from mutating admitted witness data behind these borrows.
